# Magic Mahjong

Magic Mahjong
Input file: standard input
Output file: standard output
Time limit: 1 second
Memory limit: 1024 megabytes
Starlight Glimmer is working on Magic Mahjong with her friends.
There are two types of Mahjong tiles, Suited and Honors, of which:
Suited tiles are divided into two suits and each are numbered from 1 to 9. The suits are bamboos, dots,
and characters. There are four identical copies of each suited tile totaling 108 tiles.
For Honors, there are two different sets of honors tiles: winds and dragons. The winds are east, south,
west, and north, beginning with east. The dragons are red, green, and white.
Now, we denote dots by numbers as P = {1p, 2p, 3p, 4p, 5p, 6p, 7p, 8p, 9p}, and similarly, bamboos as
S = {1s, 2s, 3s, 4s, 5s, 6s, 7s, 8s, 9s}, and characters as M = {1m, 2m, 3m, 4m, 5m, 6m, 7m, 8m, 9m}. For
Honors, it is noted as Z = {1z, 2z, 3z, 4z, 5z, 6z, 7z} in the order of East, South, West, North, White,
Green, Red.
In particular, we call T = {1p, 9p, 1s, 9s, 1m, 9m} the terminal tile.
There are three types of Wins in Magic Mahjong, and Starlight Glimmer wants to explore just two of
them today, both of which require 14 tiles to reach the Win condition:
• Thirteen Orphans, which is a limit hand that consists of all terminal and honor tile. In other
words, the Win condition must have each 13 terminal and honor tile and attach any card belonging
to the first 13 tile. Formally, it must be a muiltset T ∪ Z ∪ {x|x ∈ T ∪ Z}.
An example of Thirteen Orphans which has two 1p.
Note that the set is unordered.
• 7 Pairs, which consists of only 7 different tiles and each tile must appear twice. Formally, consider
a set L of size 7 whose element is in Mahjong tiles, the muiltset L ∪ L is a legal 7 Pairs.
Now Starlight Glimmer is given a number of her starting 14 cards, and she wonders if a Win condition
has been reached as above.
Page 1 of 2

Input
There are multiple test cases. The first line contains an integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 1000) indicating the number
of test cases, for each test case:
A string of length 28 spliced directly from Starlight Glimmer’s starting 14 cards (NOT separated by
spaces).
Output
For each test case, print a single string, for Thirteen Orphans Win condition, print “Thirteen Orphans”,
for 7 Pairs Win condition, print “7 Pairs”, otherwise, print “Otherwise”.
Example
standard input standard output
6
1s9s1p9p1m9m1z2z3z4z5z6z7z9s
1s9s1p9p1s9s1p9p2s2p2s2p3s3s
1s1s1s2s3s4s5s6s7s8s9s9s9s5s
9s1p1s1m1z7z6z5z4z9p9m2z3z2z
1p2p3p1p2p3p7s8s9s7s8s9s1z1z
1p1p1p1p2p2p2p2p3p3p3p3p4p4p
Thirteen Orphans
7 Pairs
Otherwise
Thirteen Orphans
7 Pairs
Otherwise

content.sourceText:
# Magic Mahjong

## Description

Starlight Glimmer is playing Magic Mahjong with her friends.

Mahjong tiles are divided into suited tiles and honors.

Suited tiles have three suits: bamboos, dots and characters. Each suit is numbered from 1 to 9, with four identical copies of every tile, for 108 suited tiles in total.

![Original figure](105231-J-figure1.png)

Honors are divided into winds and dragons. The winds, starting from east, are east, south, west and north; the dragons are red, green and white.

![Original figure](105231-J-figure2.png)

Dots are denoted by $P=\{1p,2p,3p,4p,5p,6p,7p,8p,9p\}$; similarly bamboos are $S=\{1s,2s,3s,4s,5s,6s,7s,8s,9s\}$ and characters are $M=\{1m,2m,3m,4m,5m,6m,7m,8m,9m\}$. Honors are $Z=\{1z,2z,3z,4z,5z,6z,7z\}$, in the order east, south, west, north, white, green, red.

The terminal tiles are $T=\{1p,9p,1s,9s,1m,9m\}$.

There are three kinds of winning hands in Magic Mahjong. Today Starlight Glimmer studies only the following two, both requiring 14 tiles:

- **Thirteen Orphans:** all thirteen terminal and honor tile types must each appear, together with one extra copy of any of these types. Formally, the hand is the multiset $T\cup Z\cup\{x\mid x\in T\cup Z\}$.

![Original figure](105231-J-figure3.png)

An example of Thirteen Orphans with two $1p$ tiles. The tiles are unordered.

- **7 Pairs:** the hand contains exactly seven distinct tile types, each appearing twice. Formally, for a set $L$ of size $7$ consisting of Mahjong tile types, the multiset $L\cup L$ is a valid hand of this kind.

Given several starting hands of 14 tiles, determine whether each hand already satisfies either winning condition above.

## Input

There are multiple test cases. The first line contains an integer $T$ ($1\le T\le1000$), the number of test cases.

Each case is a string of length 28 formed by directly concatenating the encodings of the 14 starting tiles, without spaces.

## Output

For each case, output `Thirteen Orphans` for that winning condition, `7 Pairs` for seven pairs, and `Otherwise` for every other hand.

## Note

The six hands in the sample are illustrated below:

![Original figure](105231-J-figure4.png)

### Sample 1

#### Input

```text
6
1s9s1p9p1m9m1z2z3z4z5z6z7z9s
1s9s1p9p1s9s1p9p2s2p2s2p3s3s
1s1s1s2s3s4s5s6s7s8s9s9s9s5s
9s1p1s1m1z7z6z5z4z9p9m2z3z2z
1p2p3p1p2p3p7s8s9s7s8s9s1z1z
1p1p1p1p2p2p2p2p3p3p3p3p4p4p
```

#### Output

```text
Thirteen Orphans
7 Pairs
Otherwise
Thirteen Orphans
7 Pairs
Otherwise
```

translation.markdown:
# Magic Mahjong

## 题目描述

Starlight Glimmer 正在和朋友们玩魔法麻将。

麻将牌分为数牌与字牌两类。

数牌分为条、筒、万三种花色，每种花色的数字从 1 到 9，每张牌都有四张相同的副本，数牌共计 108 张。

![原稿配图](105231-J-figure1.png)

字牌又分为风牌与三元牌。风牌从东开始依次为东、南、西、北；三元牌为中、发、白。

![原稿配图](105231-J-figure2.png)

筒牌记作 $P=\{1p,2p,3p,4p,5p,6p,7p,8p,9p\}$；类似地，条牌记作 $S=\{1s,2s,3s,4s,5s,6s,7s,8s,9s\}$，万牌记作 $M=\{1m,2m,3m,4m,5m,6m,7m,8m,9m\}$。字牌记作 $Z=\{1z,2z,3z,4z,5z,6z,7z\}$，依次对应东、南、西、北、白、发、中。

其中，幺九牌为 $T=\{1p,9p,1s,9s,1m,9m\}$。

魔法麻将有三种和牌牌型。今天 Starlight Glimmer 只研究下面两种，它们都需要 14 张牌：

- **十三幺（Thirteen Orphans）：** 十三种幺九牌和字牌必须各有一张，并额外有一张这十三种牌中的任意一种。形式化地说，牌组成的多重集合为 $T\cup Z\cup\{x\mid x\in T\cup Z\}$。

![原稿配图](105231-J-figure3.png)

上图是一个有两张 $1p$ 的十三幺牌型。牌的顺序不影响牌型。

- **七对子（7 Pairs）：** 手牌中恰有七种不同的牌，每种牌出现两次。形式化地说，对于一个由麻将牌种类构成、大小为 $7$ 的集合 $L$，多重集合 $L\cup L$ 就是合法的七对子。

现在给出若干组各有 14 张牌的初始手牌，请判断它们是否已经满足上述某种和牌条件。

## 输入格式

有多组测试数据。第一行包含一个整数 $T$（$1\le T\le1000$），表示测试用例数。

每个测试用例包含一个长度为 28 的字符串，由 14 张初始手牌的编码直接拼接而成，中间没有空格。

## 输出格式

对于每个测试用例，若为十三幺，则输出 `Thirteen Orphans`；若为七对子，则输出 `7 Pairs`；否则输出 `Otherwise`。

## 说明

样例中的六组手牌如下：

![原稿配图](105231-J-figure4.png)

### 样例 1

#### 输入

```text
6
1s9s1p9p1m9m1z2z3z4z5z6z7z9s
1s9s1p9p1s9s1p9p2s2p2s2p3s3s
1s1s1s2s3s4s5s6s7s8s9s9s9s5s
9s1p1s1m1z7z6z5z4z9p9m2z3z2z
1p2p3p1p2p3p7s8s9s7s8s9s1z1z
1p1p1p1p2p2p2p2p3p3p3p3p4p4p
```

#### 输出

```text
Thirteen Orphans
7 Pairs
Otherwise
Thirteen Orphans
7 Pairs
Otherwise
```
